usage: 巴西 is used to refer to the country Brazil.
You can use 巴西 in sentences when talking about travel or geography to specify the country.
It is often combined with verbs like 去 (heoi3, to go), 係 (hai6, to be), or 飛 (fei1, to fly) when describing actions related to Brazil.
In conversations, 巴西 can be a subject or object to describe nationality, origin, or destination.
